text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. These help teams stay focused and know exactly what success looks like. It is also important to set milestones—key points in time when you check your progress. Deliverables, such as reports or products, show what the project will produce. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because everyone involved should agree on the goals from the beginning. When all these elements work together, projects are more likely to finish on time and meet expectations.
